limitations: Independent review is separate; aggregate-label, missing mount-identity and stacked-mount ambiguity issues were corrected. The final source/test hashes above match the independent receipt, whose publication verdict does not authorize production execution or certify recovery.
Cooperative elapsed checks cannot interrupt a blocked kernel operation and are not a hard timeout.

Mount metadata is a bounded snapshot; a concurrently added same-device mount can escape snapshot exclusions. No namespace lock or openat2 RESOLVE_NO_XDEV guarantee is provided. Mount namespace immutability and Railway volume ID are not proved.
Filesystem entries may change during scanning. Descriptor identity checks catch tested substitutions but do not create a consistent volume snapshot.

Output lists observed unique regular-file sums, not atomic filesystem values, disk usage totals or a whole-volume certificate. Concurrent changes mean these sums are not guaranteed lower bounds. Directory overhead and other filesystem allocation are excluded.
Hardlinked inode totals go to their first observed path/group; later aliases do not add bytes. Inode reuse during concurrent changes is not excluded.
Fixed financial samples are collected only if encountered within traversal bounds; missing samples mean not observed, not absent.
Output filenames and metadata may be private and require review before sharing. No file contents, hashes, account fields or credentials are included.
Production filesystem, current financial state, account exposure, restart safety and profitable trading remain unverified.
